Most events pass. A few leave a mark. This one could help shape the best decades of your life.

On October 27, join us for 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗟𝗼𝗻𝗴𝗲𝘃𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗠𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗰𝗹𝗮𝘀𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗬𝗲𝗮𝗿 with Julie Gibson Clark—ranked second on the 2023 Rejuvenation Olympics leaderboard and Founding Faculty at Longevity Life Academy.

When we launched Longevity Life Academy, we set out to do one thing: give every adult the knowledge and the tools to shape a longer, better life. Not a generic plan. Their own.

Julie is an integral part of that mission and of how we designed our unique longevity courses, including Longevity Blueprint: connecting the science of healthy aging with the practical tools to build a personalized longevity protocol.

I said it when we launched: longevity should not be a luxury good. It should be a curriculum.

𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗝𝘂𝗹𝗶𝗲—𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘄𝗵𝘆 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗺𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗰𝗹𝗮𝘀𝘀?

A single mom from Phoenix with a full-time job. No private laboratory. No seven-figure budget. Her reported biological-aging test results corresponded to a pace of about six and a half biological years per calendar decade, placing her second on the 2023 Rejuvenation Olympics leaderboard.

Now, in a Longevity Life Academy exclusive, you can learn directly from her. Live on Zoom. One hour to hear her story, understand her choices, and see how she puts them into practice.

• Her story: how she built her approach alongside work and family life.

• Her philosophy: the six pillars of longevity—nutrition, sleep, movement, supplements and wearables, stress, and the personal protocol that ties them together.

• Her daily protocol: her complete routine, hour by hour, and the thinking behind her choices.

VIP seats include an additional private Q&A with Julie. Ask her about her protocol, your own routine, where to start, and what to reconsider.

A few words on why I’m sharing it.

Longevity is becoming one of the defining conversations of this decade. People want to stay sharp, strong and independent as they grow older—and they want to understand how.

With that interest comes noise. Clinics, supplements, protocols, podcasts, and a great deal of commercial interest in telling you what to buy. It has become genuinely hard to know who to listen to, who to trust, and where to begin.

That is the gap Longevity Life Academy was built to close. eTeacher Group’s school for healthy aging brings leading longevity instructors into live, small-group classes and helps every student build a personalized protocol for a longer, better life. Our goal from day one: make longevity education accessible to anyone who wants it, not only to those who can spend millions.
